The DPI-H for Health workshop runs two tracks over two days, both taught from the same journey of one cross-border family. Each policy module asks one question of the journey and fills one sheet of the [Country Canvas](country-canvas.html). Each technical module is paired with the policy module of the same number. Switch tracks on any module page.

**Policy track** · [Technical track](#technical-track) · [Module × journey map](module-journey-map.html) · [Glossary](glossary.html) · [Journeys viewer](en/smart-trust-demo/journeys/smart-trust-demo/workshops/dpi-h-policy-track/overview/)

### Policy track

#### Day 1 · 30 November

| Module | Sheet | The question it carries | Journey steps |
|---|---|---|---|
| [**M1** From journey to capabilities](workshop-m1.html) | Sheet 1 | What had to exist for this moment to work — and where does our version of the journey break? | J1, J3a |
| [**M2** The reference architecture and where you stand](workshop-m2.html) | Sheet 2 | Which system do we use today for each block — and is it there, partly there, or absent? | J2b |
| [**M3** Standards, specifications and the core data set](workshop-m3.html) | Sheet 3 | Which standards do we adopt rather than author — and who owns the national core data set? | J2a, J3b |
{: .grid }

#### Day 2 · 1 December

| Module | Sheet | The question it carries | Journey steps |
|---|---|---|---|
| [**M4** Trust, credentials and wallets](workshop-m4.html) | Sheet 4 | Who signs, who verifies, and who would hold the national trust anchor? Name it; do not decide it. | J1, J2a, J3a, J4.0a |
| [**M5** Governance, decision rights and the legal basis](workshop-m5.html) | Sheet 4 | Who holds each decision — and what legal basis lets the record cross a border and be shared for a child? | J1, J2b, J4.0a, J4.0b, J4.1 |
| [**M6** Doing it together](workshop-m6.html) | Sheet 5 | Would your neighbour need this too? If yes, why would you each build it? | J3b, J4.0b, J4.1 |
| [**M7** First move and the investment required](workshop-m7.html) | Sheet 6 | What is realistic in twelve months with the people and money we have — and who owns it? | J4.1 |
